rows.explanation: The small, northern constellation Triangulum harbors this magnificent face-on spiral galaxy, Messier 33. Its popular names include the Pinwheel Galaxy or just the Triangulum Galaxy. M33 is over 50,000 light-years in diameter, third largest in the Local Group of galaxies after the Andromeda Galaxy (M31), and our own Milky Way. rows.explanation: Also known as the false dawn, a luminous band of zodiacal light is captured in this dark night skyscape. rows.explanation: If you went outside at the same time every day and took a picture that included the Sun, how would the Sun's position change? rows.explanation: A once-in-a-lifetime crater has appeared on the Moon!
